Draft gate failed because scopeVerification.in requirements did not include must should or nice-to-have priorities
entries.resolution: Added explicit MUST and SHOULD priority markers to all in-scope draft requirement entries

entries.reason: The requirement uses the ambiguous phrase "force 系" without defining the exact strings, fields, or matching criteria, so reviewers may disagree on which entries are important.; The requirement says important items are detected by "指定語句" and failed steps but does not enumerate the exact terms or matching rules, so reviewers may disagree on satisfaction.; The requirement "report 生成に関する unit test" does not state measurable coverage or scenarios, so reviewers may disagree on whether the test requirement is satisfied.
Draft gate failed because important issue-log criteria used ambiguous force-family wording and the test scope was not measurable
entries.resolution: Expanded important-entry matching terms and fields, and replaced the unit test scope with concrete report-generation scenarios

entries.reason: Requirement uses the vague phrase "少数 entries" without stating a verifiable entry count or range.; Requirement asks tests to cover "少数 entries" but does not define how many entries qualifies, so independent reviewers could disagree on whether the condition is satisfied.
Draft gate failed because the test scenario used the vague phrase small entries without numeric counts
entries.resolution: Replaced the vague small-entry scenario with explicit zero one and two entry cases

entries.reason: Spec review found gate failures could be missed because gate issue-log entries use level instead of result status or failureKind
entries.resolution: Added level to R2 important-entry matching and failure-origin clarification, with spec-repair audit artifact

entries.reason: Requirement R5 uses the vague condition "without misleading omitted counts" without defining which omitted-count text is allowed or prohibited for 1-entry and 2-entry cases.; Requirement R5 depends on the subjective phrase "misleading omitted counts"; two reviewers could disagree on whether an implementation satisfies it for 1-entry and 2-entry cases.
Spec gate failed because R5 used the subjective phrase misleading omitted counts
entries.resolution: Rewrote R5 and acceptance criteria to prohibit concrete omitted-count phrases when no entries are hidden

entries.reason: The spec does not list the impact on existing features or explicitly state that no existing features are affected.
Spec gate failed because impact on existing features was not explicitly listed in a gate-detectable spec field
entries.resolution: Added Impact on Existing Features text to background and impactOnExisting list with report text, report.json, issue-log persistence, and finalize-cleanup impacts

entries.reason: schema: spec.json failed schema validation: impactOnExisting: unknown field
Spec gate failed because impactOnExisting was added as an unknown top-level spec.json field
entries.resolution: Removed the schema-invalid field and kept the Impact on Existing Features section inside background

entries.reason: Static test review failed because R2 field coverage and R6 preserved-behavior coverage were incomplete
entries.resolution: Expanded R2 test cases across missing fields and added R6 load-save plus report-text display path checks

entries.reason: Static test review failed because result-field keyword matching lacked a standalone R2 test case
entries.resolution: Added ordinary result and direct failureKind field cases to the R2 spec-local test

entries.reason: Static test review failed because level keyword coverage was conflated with the gate failure special case
entries.resolution: Split R2 coverage into generic field keyword matching and failure-origin rule inputs, including a non-gate level keyword case

entries.reason: Integration gate stopped before evaluation because file-map.json was missing
entries.resolution: Recorded R1 through R6 file mappings to src/flow/commands/report.js using flow set files

entries.reason: Spec-local R6 test failed because it asserted cleanup source imports unrelated to report display behavior
entries.resolution: Removed the brittle source-text assertion and kept behavior coverage through readReportText

entries.reason: The diff adds IssueLogSummaryEntry as a new class whose only production use is inside IssueLogSummary mapping, and it only stores a source object/classification plus formats three fields; the same behavior could be local object construction without adding a separate API surface or ownership boundary.; The diff adds IssueLogSummary as a new class with a single production construction site in generateReport(), committing to a non-trivial report-summary abstraction without evidence in the spec or issue-log that this class/layer design direction was confirmed before implementation.
Integration gate failed no-overengineering because IssueLogSummaryEntry was a thin single-use class and IssueLogSummary lacked artifact evidence for the class design
entries.resolution: Removed the thin IssueLogSummaryEntry class and consolidated serialization into IssueLogSummary, which retains bounded summary invariants required by project OOP rules

entries.reason: Implementation matches keyword fields, but failure-origin logic treats any truthy failureKind as important instead of requiring failureKind to indicate failure via fail/failed/error/blocked matching.
Integration gate failed because failure-origin classification treated any non-empty failureKind as important
entries.resolution: Changed failureKind origin matching to require fail failed error or blocked terms and adjusted the spec-local final-regression case to use the reason failure signal

entries.reason: Spec-local R2 test expectation still used the old final-regression reason after aligning the fixture with failure signal wording
entries.resolution: Updated the expected important reason to final-regression failed caused_by_current_change

entries.reason: Duplicate failure-signal checks were introduced for level, result, status, and failureKind using the same control-flow shape; a local helper over those fields could remove the repeated production logic.; Duplicate subsection rendering control flow was introduced for Important and Recent Other sections: filter entries, conditionally push a title, loop entries, and conditionally push an omitted line. A local helper could remove the repeated production rendering shape.
Integration gate failed no-overengineering because failure-signal checks and issue-log subsection rendering duplicated control-flow shapes
entries.resolution: Extracted entryHasFailureSignal and pushIssueLogGroup helpers to remove repeated production logic
